'''Gossam''' was the native [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Castell/Legends|Castell]]. Most Gossams also learned to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

Spoken Gossam included croaks, lispy vocalizations, and trills. The written language was an [[Gossam alphabet|alphabet]].<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
